description: Push Notifications pipeline audit documentation and post publishing pipeline audit
steps: Create a comprehensive audit document at .agents/tasks/task-production-qa-pass-2/PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS_AUDIT.md explaining the complete push notification pipeline: (1) Token Generation: mobile/src/services/pushNotification.service.ts calls expo-notifications getExpoPushTokenAsync(), (2) Token Storage: calls notificationService.registerPushToken(token) which POSTs to /users/me/push-token - backend stores in user.pushTokens array, (3) Token Registration Timing: called from LoginScreen after successful auth (handleAuthSuccess and handleDevLogin), (4) Delivery: backend/src/shared/utils/pushNotifications.js uses expo-server-sdk to send to all valid tokens, (5) Triggering: notification.service.js calls sendPushNotifications when notifications are created. Note: timing issue is that registerForPushNotifications is called AFTER credentials are stored but the token POST requires auth - this should work because SecureStore has the token by then.

Create .agents/tasks/task-production-qa-pass-2/POST_PIPELINE_AUDIT.md documenting the 7-stage media pipeline: (1) PICKER: expo-image-picker with allowsMultipleSelection=true, selectionLimit=6-current, mediaTypes=All, quality=0.8. Max 5 images + 1 video. (2) FORMDATA: All media appended as 'media' field, filename derived from URI, mime type from extension. (3) MULTER: Check backend upload middleware configuration. (4) CLOUDINARY: Check how media array is stored. (5) MONGODB: Post model media field. (6) GET API: How media is returned. (7) RENDERING: How PostDetailScreen, Feed, Profile, Explore render media arrays. Identify where media loss could occur.

In the POST_PIPELINE_AUDIT.md, include specific findings about the media picker limit (selectionLimit = Math.max(1, 6 - mediaItems.length) which correctly allows up to 6 total), FormData construction (appends ALL items to 'media' key), and verify backend multer config accepts multiple files.
acceptance_criteria: PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS_AUDIT.md exists with complete pipeline explanation
POST_PIPELINE_AUDIT.md exists with 7-stage analysis identifying potential loss points
No code changes in this feature - documentation only
verification: Verify PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS_AUDIT.md file exists and covers all 5 stages
Verify POST_PIPELINE_AUDIT.md file exists and covers all 7 stages
findings: Both audit documents created. Pipeline analysis confirms no media loss at any stage. Post Detail correctly renders all media via FlatList. Grid views (Profile/Explore/Featured) intentionally show only first image as thumbnail.
